messages:
sam_pm: Quick sync: BlueWave (enterprise) wants a compact Console view that ties 'feature' cost to errors and deploy events for their monthly procurement review. They want something safe to ship quickly. Ideas?

vivian_back: We should avoid full payload capture initially. MVP = per-feature token cost (tokens * price snapshot) + error-rate timeline + deploy annotations. Feature -> routes mapping can be provided by customer for beta.

eli_ui: UX thought: single-card landing with feature selector, small timeline with stacked bars (token cost vs infra), and an "Investigate" CTA that fetches up to 6 traces on demand. Keep it minimal.

noah_sales: BlueWave specifically asked for an exportable one-page CSV/PDF for procurement. They need clarity on why costs spiked (token delta vs model change vs volume).

tara_sre: Operational constraints: route-level tagging (feature_tag) is low-risk. On-demand trace fetch must be rate-limited and quota'd. Auto-disable sampling if CPU delta > 3% for any host. telemetry-bot: please record.

telemetry-bot: Created flag "feature_cost_tool_beta" and alert "feature_cost_ingest_cpu_delta" threshold 3%. Notifying #eng-oncall and #eng-infra.

vivian_back: Cost formula proposal: cost = (tokens_in + tokens_out) * unit_price_at_ingest. Implementation: annotate event at ingress with price_id (daily snapshot) to avoid joins at query time.

sam_pm: Acceptance criteria sketch:
- BlueWave can select their supplied feature list and see cost/day + error-rate/day for last 30 days.
- Click an error bar -> request up to 6 sampled traces (counts against org quota).
- Export CSV with columns: feature, date, tokens_in, tokens_out, model_id, price_id, unit_price_usd, cost_usd, error_count, p95_latency_ms.

eli_ui: Also add a small "explain" tooltip that shows token change vs price change vs traffic change when a spike is selected. Helps non-technical procurement.

vivian_back: Rollout plan:
- Phase A: opt-in feature_tag only, ingest price_id, no trace storage. Console shows aggregated cost + errors.
- Phase B: on-demand traces with quota and TTL 30d compressed.
- Phase C: per-route auto-correlation and forecasting (post-beta).

noah_sales: BlueWave timeline: needs beta by end of Q2 for their June procurement meeting. Can we commit?

tara_sre: Realistic: Phase A in ~5 weeks if BlueWave supplies feature->routes map. Phase B depends on perf signoff, probably Q3.

sam_pm: Risks to call out:
- mismatched feature->route mapping if customer supplies incomplete map
- storage and egress cost of traces if abused
- edge cases when model pricing updates mid-window

vivian_back: Mitigations:
- require mapping for beta and provide a simple CSV template
- on-demand quotas + telemetry billing alerts + compression + 30d TTL
- price_id snapshot on ingest and explicit reconciliation doc for finance

eli_ui: Mockups ETA: EOD Tue. Will include export sample and tooltip microcopy.

tara_sre: I'll author the rollback/playbook: if telemetry CPU delta >3% or storage cost exceeds estimate, auto-disable trace fetch and notify PM & infra.

sam_pm: Owners:
- Product: sam_pm (BlueWave liaison + acceptance)
- Backend: vivian_back (ingest + price_id)
- UI: eli_ui (cards + export + tooltip)
- SRE: tara_sre (guardrails + alerts)
- Flags/automation: telemetry-bot

noah_sales: I'll get BlueWave to commit to mapping CSV and send legal/contract note on retention.

sam_pm: Action items: @noah_sales get mapping; @eli_ui upload mockups; @vivian_back draft ingress PR + price snapshot doc; @tara_sre draft runbook; @telemetry-bot ensure flag & alert exist. We'll reconvene next Tue.

telemetry-bot: Calendar invite created: product-observability-beta-checkin Tue 10:00.

sam_pm: Thanks all. Closing thread until next checkin.
